entries.en: Added --add-dir CLI argument for specifying additional working directories
entries.zh: 添加了 --add-dir CLI 参数以指定其他工作目录

entries.en: Added streaming input support without require -p flag
entries.zh: 添加了流输入支持，无需 -p 标志

entries.en: Added CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR environment variable to freeze working directory for bash commands
entries.zh: 添加了 CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR 环境变量以冻结 bash 命令的工作目录

entries.en: Added detailed MCP server tools display (/mcp)
entries.zh: 添加了详细的 MCP 服务器工具显示 (/mcp)

entries.en: Added auto-reconnection for MCP SSE connections on disconnect
entries.zh: 添加了断开连接时 MCP SSE 连接的自动重新连接

entries.en: Improved startup performance and session storage performance
entries.zh: 改进启动性能和会话存储性能
改进 MCP 认证和权限

entries.en: Fixed issue where pasted content was lost when dialogs appeared
entries.zh: 修复了出现对话框时粘贴内容丢失的问题
